configurations.name: appHost
configurations.description: The host of the Port Ocean app. Used to set up the integration endpoint as the target for Webhooks created in Linear. This field is deprecated. Please use the OCEAN__BASE_URL field instead.

configurations.name: linearApiKey
configurations.description: Linear personal API key. To create an API key, see the Linear API documentation.

actions.name: create_issue
actions.description: Create a new Linear issue in a team

inputs.name: teamId
inputs.title: Team ID
inputs.description: Linear team UUID. In self-service actions, map teamId from a linearTeam catalog entity identifier.

inputs.name: title
inputs.title: Title
inputs.description: The issue title

inputs.name: description
inputs.title: Description
inputs.description: Issue description in Markdown

inputs.name: assigneeId
inputs.title: Assignee ID
inputs.description: UUID of the user to assign the issue to

inputs.name: stateId
inputs.title: State ID
inputs.description: UUID of the workflow state to assign the issue to

inputs.name: projectId
inputs.title: Project ID
inputs.description: UUID of the project to associate the issue with

inputs.name: cycleId
inputs.title: Cycle ID
inputs.description: UUID of the cycle to add the issue to

inputs.name: priority
inputs.title: Priority
inputs.description: Issue priority (0 = No priority, 1 = Urgent, 2 = High, 3 = Normal, 4 = Low)

inputs.name: labelIds
inputs.title: Label IDs
inputs.description: UUIDs of labels to attach to the issue

actions.name: create_sub_issue
actions.description: Create a sub-issue under an existing Linear issue

inputs.name: parentId
inputs.title: Parent issue ID
inputs.description: UUID or identifier of the parent issue (e.g. ENG-123)

inputs.name: title
inputs.title: Title
inputs.description: The sub-issue title

inputs.name: teamId
inputs.title: Team ID
inputs.description: Optional Linear team UUID. When omitted, the parent issue's team is used. Map from a linearTeam catalog entity identifier when needed.

inputs.name: description
inputs.title: Description
inputs.description: Issue description in Markdown

inputs.name: assigneeId
inputs.title: Assignee ID
inputs.description: UUID of the user to assign the issue to

inputs.name: stateId
inputs.title: State ID
inputs.description: UUID of the workflow state to assign the issue to

inputs.name: priority
inputs.title: Priority
inputs.description: Issue priority (0 = No priority, 1 = Urgent, 2 = High, 3 = Normal, 4 = Low)

actions.name: update_issue
actions.description: Update fields on an existing Linear issue

inputs.name: issueId
inputs.title: Issue ID
inputs.description: UUID or identifier of the issue to update (e.g. ENG-123)

inputs.name: title
inputs.title: Title
inputs.description: Updated issue title

inputs.name: description
inputs.title: Description
inputs.description: Updated issue description in Markdown

inputs.name: assigneeId
inputs.title: Assignee ID
inputs.description: UUID of the user to assign the issue to

inputs.name: stateId
inputs.title: State ID
inputs.description: UUID of the workflow state to move the issue to

inputs.name: projectId
inputs.title: Project ID
inputs.description: UUID of the project to associate the issue with

inputs.name: cycleId
inputs.title: Cycle ID
inputs.description: UUID of the cycle to add the issue to

inputs.name: priority
inputs.title: Priority
inputs.description: Issue priority (0 = No priority, 1 = Urgent, 2 = High, 3 = Normal, 4 = Low)

inputs.name: delegateId
inputs.title: Delegate ID
inputs.description: UUID of the agent app user to delegate the issue to

inputs.name: labelIds
inputs.title: Label IDs
inputs.description: UUIDs of labels to attach to the issue

actions.name: change_status
actions.description: Move a Linear issue to a different workflow state

inputs.name: issueId
inputs.title: Issue ID
inputs.description: UUID or identifier of the issue to update (e.g. ENG-123)

inputs.name: stateId
inputs.title: State ID
inputs.description: UUID of the target workflow state

inputs.name: stateName
inputs.title: State name
inputs.description: Name of the target workflow state in the issue's team. Provide stateId or stateName.

actions.name: add_comment
actions.description: Add a comment to a Linear issue

inputs.name: issueId
inputs.title: Issue ID
inputs.description: UUID or identifier of the issue to comment on (e.g. ENG-123)

inputs.name: body
inputs.title: Comment body
inputs.description: Comment content in Markdown

actions.name: add_document
actions.description: Create a Linear document linked to an issue or project

inputs.name: title
inputs.title: Title
inputs.description: Document title

inputs.name: content
inputs.title: Content
inputs.description: Document content in Markdown

inputs.name: issueId
inputs.title: Issue ID
inputs.description: UUID or identifier of the related issue. Provide issueId or projectId.

inputs.name: projectId
inputs.title: Project ID
inputs.description: UUID of the related project. Provide issueId or projectId.
